items.label: Bright Green Beam
items.value: The lase level has a bright cross-line green laser that is easily projected at a wide Angle of 110°, which can assist your leveling work.

items.label: 100FT Self-Leveling
items.value: When you unlock the pendulum, the laser level will automatically level itself within a 3.5°range. If the surface is tilted more than 3.5°degrees, it will continuously flash, alerting you to the horizontal state.

items.label: Compact Design
items.value: With light-weight and palm-sized design, the line laser is easy to carry.

items.label: High-Quality
items.value: it's IP54 waterproof, dustproof amd shockproof. Laser Class: Class 2 and Laser Wavelength: 635nm Power Output: <1mW

items.label: Multi-Functional
items.value: It is perfect for picture hanging, construction projects, DIY decoration, and so on. It is a compact and practical option for basic cross-line leveling work.

items.label: Easy to Use
items.value: Simply press the button on the laser-level tool and start working. It also features a 1/4'' screw hole on the bottom, allowing compatibility with most tripods.

items.label: Useful Tripod
items.value: The tripod can be extended up to 26 inches to help you adjust the position of the laser for maximum accuracy.

items.label: Portable Battery
items.value: The self-leveling laser level is equipped with two AA batteries, easy to replace, and supports up to 6 hours of continuous work, giving you the easiest and most efficient work experience.

items.label: Package Contents
items.value: 1x 100ft Green Laser Level, 2x AA Batteries,1x Carry-on bag, 1x User Manual, 1x Tripod
